description: Official public Agent Memory Benchmark suites integrated into Raw Memory (`raw-memory-eval bench`). External academic datasets are downloaded on demand to a local cache directory so this repository stays lightweight and license-clean.

locomo.name: LoCoMo (Long-Context Conversational Memory)
locomo.notes: Evaluates both raw turn retrieval (L1) and curated episode+observation retrieval (L1+L2+L3) with exact dia_id evidence traceability.

longmemeval-oracle.name: LongMemEval-Oracle (Cleaned)
longmemeval-oracle.notes: Evidence sessions only (~36 turns/question); isolates turn-level pinpointing precision across all 6 memory pillars.

longmemeval-s.name: LongMemEval-S (Cleaned, ~115k tokens / ~48 sessions per question)
longmemeval-s.notes: Full haystack retrieval across ~48 distractor sessions (~494 turns/question, 246,750 turns total). Evaluates Session R@K/NDCG@K and Turn R@K/NDCG@K.

reflexive-meta.name: Raw Memory Reflexive Meta Benchmark (RFC-0003)
reflexive-meta.notes: Tests causal H_<t time-travel isolation, bi-temporal supersession, cross-channel anchors, privacy boundaries, and 5-generation anti-echo stability.
